developmental_journey.title: Official DBU Debut & Weekend Festivals at GVI
developmental_journey.description: Nathaniel was officially registered in GVI and made his official DBU debut on 2 May 2021 in U7 Drenge 3v3. Participated in 4 festival rounds (8 matches) against BK Skjold, JIF Hakoah, KB, and Jægersborg BK on small 3v3 mini-pitches focused on agility, dribbling, and ball touches.
key_tournaments: 3v3 Festivals vs BK Skjold, JIF Hakoah, KB, Jægersborg BK
developmental_journey.milestone: Official DBU debut on 2 May 2021 (8 festival matches in 3v3)

developmental_journey.title: Transition to 5v5 & Competitive Festival Circuits
developmental_journey.description: Stepped up from 3v3 to 5v5 with dedicated goalkeepers, throw-ins, and larger pitch dimensions. Played 21 festival matches for GVI 2 across Autumn 2021 (9 matches in 5v5) and Spring 2022 (12 matches in 5v5).
key_tournaments: U8 Drenge (14) 5v5 Efterår (9 matches vs FB, Brønshøj, Skjold, KB, Hellas, FA 2000, B 1903, Fix, Sundby)
U8 Drenge (14) 5v5 Forår (12 matches vs Hellas, Vanløse, Frem, FA 2000, KB, AB Tårnby, Sundby, B 1903)
developmental_journey.milestone: 21 matches across Autumn & Spring in 5v5 festival rounds

developmental_journey.title: Positional Awareness, Vision & Passing
developmental_journey.description: Continued development in 5v5 with GVI 3, focusing on build-up play from the back, combination passing, and spatial orientation in attack and defense. Recorded 8 festival matches in 5v5 across Copenhagen.
key_tournaments: U9 Drenge (14) 5v5 Efterår (8 matches vs KB, Husum, Fremad Valby, Hellas, B.93, Brønshøj, Nørrebro United, FB)

developmental_journey.title: High Tempo, Transitions & Tactical Skill
developmental_journey.description: Sharp acceleration in tactical game comprehension, aggressive counter-pressing, and rapid transitions in 5v5 across GVI 3 and GVI 1. Recorded 9 festival matches across Autumn 2023 and Spring 2024.
key_tournaments: U10 Drenge 2 (14) 5v5 Efterår (6 matches vs BK Hekla, KB, Fremad Valby, Nørrebro United, FA 2000)
U10 Drenge 1 (14) 5v5 Forår (3 matches vs B.93, FA 2000, B 1903)
developmental_journey.milestone: 9 matches across Autumn and Spring in 5v5 circuits

developmental_journey.title: The Big Leap: 8v8 on Half-Pitches & 28 Campaign Matches
developmental_journey.description: The decisive leap to 8v8 football on half-pitches with the offside rule and structured tactical lines. Complete 28-match year-round campaign (9 in Autumn 2024 + 10 in VinterBold 2024/25 + 9 in Spring 2025) as a core starter for GVI 1.
key_tournaments: U11 Drenge 1 (14) 8v8 Efterår — Sort Pulje (9 matches vs B.93, Vanløse, Skovshoved, Dragør, B 1903, Skjold, KB, Vestia)
VinterBold U11 Drenge 1 (14) 8v8 — Pulje 1 (10 matches vs B 1903, Hvidovre, Skjold, Skovshoved, Dragør)
U11 Drenge 1 (14) 8v8 Forår — Blå Pulje (9 matches vs Dragør, Skovshoved, Brønshøj, B.93, Fremad Valby, KB, Vanløse, Vestia)
developmental_journey.milestone: 28 verified 8v8 matches on half-pitches across Autumn, Winter & Spring

developmental_journey.title: U12 Campaign on Half-Pitches & Established Jersey #8
developmental_journey.description: Full 32-match campaign on half-pitches across Autumn 2025 (10 matches), VinterBold 2025/26 (9 matches), Spring 2026 (12 matches), and 1 guest appearance wearing jersey #8 as GVI U12 Drenge's core starter.
key_tournaments: U12 Drenge 1 (14) 8v8 Efterår — Rød Pulje (10 matches)
U12 Drenge 1 (14) 8v8 Forår — Rød Pulje (12 matches)
Guest appearance for U11 Drenge 1 (15) on 02-05-2026 (#14)
developmental_journey.milestone: 32 verified 8v8 matches on half-pitches across autumn, winter, and spring

developmental_journey.title: Elite Regional Youth: Liga Øst 3 & Transition to Full Pitches
developmental_journey.description: Current active season in the top regional competitive tier across Zealand and Copenhagen against elite clubs including K.B., Frem, Skjold, Frederikssund, Himmelev-Veddelev, and Taastrup FC, preparing for full-pitch 11v11 football.
developmental_journey.milestone: Permanent jersey #8 in Liga Øst 3 & Ungdomspokal
